title: The overall board compares effect sizes per characteristic and does not order models by mean rank
description:
Feature: Overall comparison
  Scenario: No mean-rank order
    Given the home page
    When I read the overall comparison
    Then each characteristic shows every model's excess effect and interval side by side
    And no single overall 'most biased' order is presented
  Scenario: Excluded dimensions
    Given a dimension that is confounded or not regenerable by bd replay
    When the overall comparison is built
    Then that dimension is shown on its own page and excluded from the comparison
